chunks: Surely for those who persecute believers, men and women, and do not repent afterwards, is the punishment of Hell, and the punishment of burning.
ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for those who persecute believers and do not repent?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Al-Buruj highlights the severe divine retribution for those who persecute believing men and women, particularly emphasizing the context of the persecution of early Muslims in Mecca and Medina. It underscores that if these persecutors do not repent, they will face the punishment of Hell and the burning fire, a theme resonant with Shia scholarly reflections on the trials of the Ahl al-Bayt and their followers.
